excerpt: Figure 11 compares RMAE over render time for MIS, Moreau et al.'s light BVH, streaming RIS, biased spatiotemporal reuse, unbiased spatiotemporal reuse, and biased spatial-only reuse; the text reports that biased spatiotemporal reuse has the lowest error at interactive render times.
overview: The error-curve comparison supports the claim that ReSTIR's reuse is useful beyond isolated image examples. It also clarifies the tradeoff: the biased version tends to win at interactive budgets, while bias can dominate at longer render times and the unbiased version can eventually become preferable.
title: Interactive Error Curve Results
